macros.name: askmap
macros.doc: The command \askmap provides a drop-in replacement for the command \karnaughmap from the Karnaugh package.

macros.name: askmapbitcombinationsize
macros.doc: The command \askmapbitcombinationsize sets the size and typeface for the bit combinations at the top and the left.

macros.name: askmapcontentsize
macros.doc: The command \askmapcontentsize sets the size and typeface for the cell’s contents.

macros.name: askmapindexsize
macros.doc: The command \askmapindexsize sets the size and typeface of the minterm numbers in the cells.

macros.name: askmapunitlength
macros.doc: The new dimension \askmapunitlength is available and specifies the length and width of the squares.

macros.name: askmapvarsep
macros.doc: The command \askmapvarsep sets the relative line length of the variable separator on the left of the Karnaugh map.
